summary: We created an interactive storytelling experience that brings NASA’s abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars to life for young space enthusiasts. Through a simple map and short emotional stories, users discover the hardware left behind from Apollo descent stages to the Opportunity rover , and learn the science and human stories behind each mission. Our project turns forgotten machines into memorable lessons, making space history accessible, emotional, and inspiring for school-age audiences. Hope you enjoy :)
details: Space Heritage Atlas is a web-based exploration platform that investigates space hardware abandonment and orbital artifacts across celestial bodies. Featuring integrated NASA Trek WMTS imagery for the Moon and Mars, the platform offers an interactive map experience paired with a custom return-fuel calculator. Built as a lightweight, browser-accessible resource, it combines spatial data tools with educational insights to highlight the footprint of space exploration.
